purpose: Give Codex/agents concrete, licensable targets to acquire, stage, normalize and integrate without browsing entire marketplaces or importing whole packs blindly.

rules.coordinateContract: meters, +Y up, +Z preferred front, bottom-center/ground pivot
rules.genericAssetRule: Generic assets may provide architecture, clutter, nature and base materials. Ohm, Galvanoscope, Puerta Ω and visible electrical mechanisms remain identity/hero assets and must not be replaced by generic store assets.

materials.use: Primary Plaza paving, roughly 50-65% of walkable ground.
materials.integration: Tile using real-world scale; runtime 1K; no displacement texture in runtime; use normal + roughness and geometry only where silhouette matters.

materials.use: Water edges, drains, wall feet and low-traffic seams; 10-20% coverage, never full-ground green noise.
materials.integration: Blend by vertex color/decal/mask against the base cobble. Runtime 1K.

materials.use: Main retaining walls, arches and substantial Plaza masonry.
materials.integration: Hue/value-grade toward pale taupe Ohmdal stone. Runtime 1K. Keep mortar scale consistent across modules.

materials.use: Older perimeter walls, retaining bands, inaccessible background masonry and repaired patches.
materials.integration: Do not randomly alternate every wall. Reserve for age hierarchy and damp/old zones. Runtime 1K.

materials.use: Taller façade infill, sheltered wall faces and selected upper architecture so the city is not 100% exposed stone.
materials.integration: Runtime 1K. Use decals/geometry for large missing chunks instead of runtime displacement.

materials.use: Taller doors, benches, shutters, braces, carts and secondary wood props.
materials.integration: Runtime 1K. Avoid covering all wood with a single UV scale; preserve plank dimensions.

materials.use: Non-copper structural iron: hinges, brackets, grilles, worn tool metal, drain covers.
materials.integration: Runtime 1K. Do not substitute this for Ohmdal copper conductors.

materials.acquire: Create once as a shared PBR material; no marketplace download required.
materials.use: Conductors, bus bars, rails, trims and electrical infrastructure.
materials.integration: Base copper metallic material plus controlled verdigris mask. Copper base around warm brown/orange, metallic=1; verdigris layer is rough/non-metal-like surface oxidation. No emissive glow unless actual energized feedback requires it.

geometryPacks.freeTier: Standard/free version exposes roughly 60-70% of the pack in OBJ/FBX/glTF according to the author.
geometryPacks.use: Fast modular massing and secondary/background architecture. Extract individual glTF pieces; never ship or import the whole pack into the scene.
geometryPacks.integration: Inventory filenames after extraction, select only needed pieces, normalize scale/pivot/materials in Blender, then inspect/calibrate GLB. For foreground signature architecture, rebuild/modify enough that it reads as Ohmdal rather than Quaternius.

geometryPacks.freeTier: Standard/free version exposes roughly 60-70% of the pack in OBJ/FBX/glTF according to the author.
geometryPacks.use: Controlled dressing around Taller/edges: storage, furniture, tools and lived-in props.
geometryPacks.integration: Prefer glTF. Share materials/atlas where possible. Recolor/desaturate to Ohmdal palette; do not scatter props uniformly. Cluster them by function.

geometryPacks.freeTier: Standard/free version exposes roughly 60-70% of the pack in OBJ/FBX/glTF according to the author.
geometryPacks.use: Rocks, sparse vegetation, wall-edge plants and silhouette framing outside high-traffic Plaza center.
geometryPacks.integration: Start with 3 rock variants, 2 bush/plant families, grass clumps and at most 2 tree silhouettes. Regrade saturated greens to dusty muted Ohmdal vegetation. Instance repeated assets.

geometryPacks.use: Only if Plaza perimeter/old infrastructure needs broken masonry or archaeological remnants.
geometryPacks.integration: Do not make the city read as destroyed. Ohmdal is detained/forgotten, not post-apocalyptic; use ruin fragments sparingly.

geometryPacks.use: Metrics/blockout only unless a specific secondary piece survives art review.
geometryPacks.integration: Do not let the final Plaza inherit Kenney's low-poly material language.
Discard or heavily transform before final foreground art.

heroDoNotSourceGeneric: signature conductor/insulator assemblies that teach circuit topology
agentProcedure: Read this catalog and the 3D production guide; do not browse for alternatives unless a listed asset is unavailable or fails art/performance review.
For each Poly Haven material, run the provided 3d:fetch-polyhaven command with --dry-run first, then without --dry-run. Raw files land under assets/source/vendor and remain git-ignored.

For Quaternius/Kenney packs, open the exact source/download page, confirm CC0 on the page at acquisition time, download the free pack, extract into the listed staging folder, and generate a filename inventory before selecting assets.
Never move an entire vendor pack into assets/runtime. Select only files used by the scene.
Normalize selected geometry in Blender: meters, +Y up, +Z preferred front, ground pivot, useful names, no hidden junk, simple colliders where needed.
Export GLB, then run inspect-glb/calibrate-model and npm run 3d:validate-glb -- <file>.
Use 1K runtime textures for generic surfaces and 2K only for hero/close-up surfaces after camera evidence. Do not ship displacement maps by default.
Instance repeated props/nature. Preserve a small material set. Measure draw calls/triangles before expanding dressing.
Record exact source URL, provider, license, original asset name, acquisition date and modifications in the surviving asset manifest/provenance.
Integrate in small batches: base materials -> modular architecture -> clutter -> nature -> lighting -> hero assets. Capture desktop/mobile after each major batch.
